back: A statement of the income and expenditure of a club for the period on the accruals basis; the result is a surplus or deficit.
Opening accumulated fund + surplus (or − deficit) of the year.
Income in the income and expenditure account.
Credited to a specific fund in the statement of financial position, not to income.
Recorded as an asset at its value, with a matching credit to a capital fund.
Spread over a stated number of years (the rest is deferred income) or credited to the accumulated fund.
Equipment bought is an asset; only depreciation is expenditure.
Net assets = accumulated fund + other funds.
A surplus that depends on fundraising events may not be repeated.
